units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 0
units.source: Manager Chen, there are a few clauses in the contract I'd like to confirm.
units.translation: Gerente Chen, hay algunas cláusulas del contrato que quisiera confirmar.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 1
units.source: No problem, go ahead.
units.translation: No hay problema, adelante.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 2
units.source: Clause three mentions a "non-compete restriction" — what does it specifically cover?
units.translation: La tercera cláusula menciona una «restricción de no competencia». ¿Qué abarca concretamente?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 3
units.source: It mainly restricts you from joining a direct competitor within two years of starting.
units.translation: Principalmente te impide incorporarte a un competidor directo durante los dos años posteriores a tu ingreso.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 4
units.source: Isn't this time period a bit long?
units.translation: ¿No es un plazo un poco largo?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 5
units.source: Um, this is the company's standard clause, but it can be discussed further.
units.translation: Esta es la cláusula estándar de la empresa, aunque puede analizarse más.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 6
units.source: Also, what are the evaluation criteria for the probation period?
units.translation: Además, ¿cuáles son los criterios de evaluación del periodo de prueba?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 7
units.source: It's mainly based on your work performance and team feedback.
units.translation: Se basa principalmente en tu desempeño laboral y en los comentarios del equipo.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 8
units.source: Could these criteria be written into a formal document?
units.translation: ¿Podrían incluirse estos criterios en un documento formal?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Reviewing Contract Terms · dialogue line 9
units.source: Sure, I'll send you the detailed criteria separately.
units.translation: Claro, te enviaré los criterios detallados por separado.

units.source: "关于...，我有些不同的看法" ("regarding..., I have a somewhat different view") is a standard, face-saving opener for professional disagreement.
units.translation: «关于...，我有些不同的看法» («respecto a..., tengo un punto de vista algo diferente») es una fórmula profesional habitual que permite expresar desacuerdo sin hacer perder las formas a nadie.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Pushing Back on an Unfavorable Clause · grammar (关于 + topic，我有些不同的看法)
units.source: Jumping straight to 我不同意 (I disagree), which sounds abrupt in a formal negotiation — the fuller phrase softens the opening.
units.translation: Empezar directamente con 我不同意 («no estoy de acuerdo»), que puede sonar brusco en una negociación formal; la fórmula completa suaviza el inicio.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)
units.source: 除了...，具体包括哪些 for asking about a full package
units.translation: 除了...，具体包括哪些 para preguntar por un paquete completo

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)
units.source: Ask for a complete breakdown of something beyond the obvious part
units.translation: Solicitar un desglose completo de algo, además de la parte evidente

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)
units.source: "除了...，具体包括哪些？" asks for a complete, itemized answer beyond what's already known — precise and professional.
units.translation: «除了...，具体包括哪些？» solicita una respuesta completa y detallada más allá de lo que ya se conoce; es una fórmula precisa y profesional.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)
units.source: Asking the vaguer 还有什么 (what else is there), which invites a less complete answer than the specific 具体包括哪些.
units.translation: Preguntar de forma más imprecisa 还有什么 («¿qué más hay?»), que invita a una respuesta menos completa que 具体包括哪些.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (除了 + known item，具体包括哪些？)

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: 如果我提出...呢？ for floating a hypothetical request
units.translation: 如果我提出...呢？ para plantear una petición hipotética

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: Test the waters on a request without formally demanding it
units.translation: Sondear una petición sin formular todavía una exigencia formal

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: "如果我提出...呢？" ("what if I proposed...?") floats an idea hypothetically, giving both sides room to negotiate without commitment.
units.translation: «如果我提出...呢？» («¿y si propusiera...?») plantea una idea de forma hipotética y da margen a ambas partes para negociar sin comprometerse.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: Making a direct demand (我要...) instead of floating it hypothetically first — the hypothetical framing keeps the negotiation collaborative.
units.translation: Formular una exigencia directa (我要...) en vez de plantearla primero como hipótesis; la formulación hipotética mantiene una negociación colaborativa.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: What if I proposed increasing the number of remote work days?
units.translation: ¿Y si propusiera aumentar el número de días de trabajo remoto?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: What if I proposed increasing the budget?
units.translation: ¿Y si propusiera aumentar el presupuesto?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar example (如果我提出 + request + 呢？)
units.source: What if I proposed changing the time?
units.translation: ¿Y si propusiera cambiar la hora?

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (Items + 综合起来 + assessment)
units.source: 综合起来 for evaluating a package as a whole
units.translation: 综合起来 para valorar un paquete en conjunto

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (Items + 综合起来 + assessment)
units.source: Give an overall assessment considering multiple factors together
units.translation: Ofrecer una valoración general teniendo en cuenta varios factores en conjunto

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (Items + 综合起来 + assessment)
units.source: "综合起来" ("taken together, combined") signals you're weighing multiple factors as a whole rather than one in isolation.
units.translation: «综合起来» («en conjunto») indica que estás sopesando varios factores como un todo en lugar de considerarlos por separado.

units.context: Scenario: Negotiating a Job Contract · Lesson: Negotiating Benefits and Perks · grammar (Items + 综合起来 + assessment)
units.source: Evaluating each benefit separately without this summarizing phrase, which misses the chance to signal an overall positive (or negative) impression.
units.translation: Evaluar cada beneficio por separado sin esta expresión de síntesis, con lo que se pierde la oportunidad de comunicar una impresión general positiva o negativa.
